hero.heading: Connecting India's Agriculture Students
hero.description: GreenRoot is an agricultural institute and student internship platform dedicated to helping Indian agriculture students secure international internships and training abroad — with hands-on experience in dairy farming, poultry, horticulture, and field crops.

images.mainAlt: GreenRoot students together during an international agricultural programme abroad
images.secondaryAlt: Hands-on field training on an international farm

story.heading: Helping Indian agriculture students train and intern abroad since 2019.
story.description: Founded in 2019 by Ex-AGRICOS, GreenRoot was built for current agriculture college students in India. From the beginning, our focus has been connecting Indian agriculture students with international internship and training opportunities on farms and agricultural organisations worldwide.

chapters.title: Our Mission
chapters.label: Mission
chapters.body: To provide Indian agriculture students with the best international internship and training platforms — transforming their careers through hands-on work experience on farms abroad, modern production operations, and skill development. To connect Indian agriculture students with global agricultural professionals and organisations.

chapters.title: Our Vision
chapters.label: Vision
chapters.body: To be India's leading platform for international agricultural internships and training — partnering with organisations worldwide to place Indian agriculture students in meaningful, paid internship programmes abroad.

chapters.title: Our Track Record
chapters.label: Since 2019
chapters.body: Through our Agri Professional Development Program, Indian agriculture students get the opportunity to intern and train abroad for up to one year. More than 100 students have been placed in dairy, poultry, horticulture, and field crops across Denmark, Germany, the USA, Israel, Australia, and other countries.

pillars.heading: Integrity, transparency & dedicated support
pillars.description: Three core values that guide every international internship placement for Indian agriculture students.

items.title: Integrity
items.text: Honest, reliable guidance for Indian agriculture students throughout the international internship application and placement process.

items.title: Transparency
items.text: Clear communication about programmes, countries, requirements, timelines, and costs at every stage of your internship journey.

items.title: Dedicated Support
items.text: End-to-end support from application through screening, partner review, visa process, and pre-departure preparation.

team.heading: The People Behind GreenRoot
team.description: Agriculture professionals committed to connecting Indian students with international internship opportunities abroad.

goals.heading: International Internship Programmes
goals.description: Paid internship and training programmes abroad, designed to give Indian agriculture students hands-on experience and career-ready skills on a global stage.
goals.imageAlt: Students working on an international farm

items.title: International Internships
items.text: Tailored programmes in Denmark, Germany, the USA, Israel, and Australia — covering dairy farming, crop production, horticulture, and agribusiness management with hands-on exposure to modern techniques.

items.title: Agri Professional Development Program
items.text: A one-year abroad internship and training programme for Indian agriculture students, building skills in sustainable agriculture, precision farming, and agribusiness management.

items.title: Pre-Departure Preparation
items.text: Guidance on documentation, visa process, and pre-departure training to help Indian agriculture students prepare for their international internship abroad.

items.title: End-to-End Application Support
items.text: From profile creation to placement abroad — our team supports Indian agriculture students through screening, partner review, and every stage of the application journey.
